decisions.reason: Bleaching tray blanks are a low-cost consumable extension of the firm's established thermoforming line, had their own page through 2019, and cost little to keep as an open option.
A PETG thermoforming blank fits the firm's core material portfolio and showed sustained presence, so the evidence supports keeping it rather than abandoning it.

The UV-curing lacquer is only mentioned on the website and its value is less clear, but it is a cheap lab consumable that complements the firm's digital and 3D-print workflows, so keeping the option open is justified.

Custom hearing protection earmolds use the same digital custom-earmold manufacturing base at little extra cost and serve a steady occupational-safety demand, so the firm keeps them even after pruning the other earmold line.
